evidence: Clicking "New Resume" created a blank "Untitled Resume" with empty Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills tabs ready for editing.
Template tab offers Modern, Classic, Minimal presets; selecting Classic instantly re-styled the Live Preview (bullet separators, reordered layout) while retaining all entered content.

Entered Contact (name/email/phone/location), Summary, Work Experience (company/title/dates/description), Education (institution/degree/field/dates/GPA), and Skills (name+level) — all accepted and reflected in the editor and preview.
Sections tab allows reordering (↑/↓) sections and renaming headings via inline textboxes (e.g., "Education" → "My Education"), both changes applied.
"Live Preview" panel renders the full formatted resume alongside the editor; "Hide Preview"/"Show Preview" toggle button works correctly.
Card options menu (Rename/Duplicate/Delete) — Duplicate created "... (Copy)"; Rename dialog with Save button successfully changed title to "QA Test Resume - Frontend Application".
Multiple distinct resume versions (original 3 + newly created + duplicated) coexisted on the dashboard, each independently editable within the session.

Search box filtered list to only "Marketing Manager Resume" when searching "Marketing"; sort combobox (Newest/Oldest/Title A-Z/Title Z-A) correctly reordered cards, e.g. Title A-Z produced alphabetical order.

issue: No validation of chronological/logical time-frame conflicts for experience/education dates
actual: Set Work Experience Start Date=2020-01 and End Date=2019-01 (end before start, an invalid/conflicting range). The app accepted the input with no warning/error and displayed "Jan 2020 - Jan 2019" in the live preview unmodified.

evidence: Date fields are native `type="month"` inputs; attempting to fill a malformed value ("notadate") was rejected by the browser input control itself (Playwright raised "Malformed value"), so only valid YYYY-MM values can be entered.

issue: Saved resume data is not actually persisted — lost on page reload
actual: Created "QA Test Resume - Backend Developer" and its duplicate "QA Test Resume - Frontend Application" (both fully filled with contact/experience/education/skills). After navigating within the app they persisted, but after a full page reload (http://localhost:7005/) both custom resumes disappeared entirely — dashboard reverted to only the original 3 seed resumes (Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Software Engineer).

evidence: Each edit (contact fields, summary, experience, education, skills, template, section rename/reorder) was reflected in the Live Preview within the same snapshot with no delay or mismatched content observed.

Clicking the ↑ button for "Work Experience" immediately swapped its order with "Professional Summary" in both the Sections list and the Live Preview; renaming "Education" to "My Education" instantly updated the preview heading — both changes applied without needing an extra save/confirm step.

issue: No explicit save confirmation/feedback for resume content edits, and saves are not durable
actual: Editing resume fields (e.g., typing in Full Name) produced no toast/snackbar or any visible "Saved" indicator (Notifications region stayed empty). The only save feedback observed was the Rename dialog's own "Save" button closing the dialog. Combined with CS-11 (data lost on reload), there is no reliable feedback that content was successfully and durably saved.

evidence: Modern and Classic templates both rendered all entered sections (Contact, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills) completely with no missing or truncated fields in the accessibility tree.

Re-opening the resume after navigating back to the dashboard and back in (same session) showed all entered fields intact: Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, Summary, Experience (company/title/dates/description), Education (institution/degree/field/dates/GPA), and Skills (JavaScript) — nothing was missing.

Changed Full Name to "Frontend Copy Name Change" only in the duplicated "QA Test Resume - Frontend Application"; re-opening the original "QA Test Resume - Backend Developer" still showed "Timothee Issenmann" unaffected, confirming independent data per version.

Resume title "QA Test Resume - Backend Developer" (and after rename "QA Test Resume - Frontend Application") matched exactly between the dashboard card heading and the editor page header/title button in every view.
